snippet.title: Fall, Fall, Fall for you - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
"Fall, Fall, Fall for you" is a challenging ball physics platformer about falling over and over again to prove your love for Daisy. She laughs every time you fall, calling you a dumb idiot. B-But... maybe she doesn't mean it. Who knows?

Daisy voice by @TrinaDeuhart 

🎮 Wishlist and Play Fall, Fall, Fall for you Demo on Steam!!
